title: Corruption Detection & Recovery
objective: Mendeteksi schema rusak, link yatim, media hilang, index tidak sinkron, dan menyediakan recovery tanpa overwrite diam-diam.

acceptance.integrity_scan: Read-only scan reports unreadable schema/manifest, missing referenced paths, orphan asset files, and index mismatch.
acceptance.quarantine: Explicit repair preview moves only orphan paths into the package trash area; source assets are not deleted.
acceptance.repair_preview: Scan returns a reviewable CorruptionRepairPreview before any mutation.
acceptance.backup_before_repair: Recovery creates a complete pre-corruption-repair backup before quarantine or reindex.
acceptance.reindex: An out-of-sync index is rebuilt from the explicitly supplied referenced paths.
acceptance.recovery_log: Recovery appends a secret-free JSONL record containing backup path, quarantined paths, and reindex decision.

fixture_policy: Synthetic disposable package under the OS temp directory; no user project is read or modified.
limits: This slice verifies local service behavior only.
Automatic repair, native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, and public release remain outside this evidence.
